Each run is one process and one `gfem.solve` at one frequency, both ports excited, `tolerance=1e-6`. A time is the whole call, from the model to S (assembly, port modes and the solver's setup included); memory is the process's peak resident set during it. Wavelengths is the box width in silica wavelengths; the direct set is the share of the unknowns `pmg_gmres` solves exactly, from its INFO record. The `direct` columns repeat the model's one `direct` run, made at the thread count of its first row.

Bend, $h = 0.05$ µm: `direct` not run, its factorization, at about 48 KiB per unknown, needs about 788 GiB, more than the node holds; it was checked against `direct`'s outgoing waves from a run on a large-memory node.

Strip, straight (order 3): `direct` not run, this row measures `pmg_gmres`'s memory at order 3: its peak, less the process's memory once the model was built, is 11.5 KiB per unknown.
